title: Dream Serpent and Bleeding Eye
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene shows a woman with long curly hair and a white serpent body floating in the upper left, holding a glowing blue orb. Below her, a woman lies asleep in an ornate metal bed as red orbs bleed from her body; a dead white dog with red eyes lies on the floor. A giant bleeding eye with multiple irises dominates the starry night sky between two gothic castles.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting with a night sky containing a giant bleeding eye with multiple colored irises dripping red liquid, two gothic castles on either side. A woman with curly hair and a long white serpent lower body floats while holding a glowing blue orb. In the foreground, a woman sleeps in an ornate metal bed as red orbs emerge from her bleeding body. A white dog with red eyes lies dead on the floor. Flowers, vines, and a small red-cloaked figure holding a blue orb complete the macabre dreamlike scene.
